title: Appointment Scheduling Outreach Standard: Reminders, Preparation Instructions, Confirmation and Arrival
content:
## Standard

For appointments booked under **Appointment Scheduling**, Riverbend Regional Health applies the following outreach standard, each element reading the figure or setting of the visit type:

- Reminders go out on each of the visit type's reminder days before the appointment, through the visit type's reminder channels.
- Preparation instructions (the fasting hours and the escort requirement) go out the visit type's preparation-instruction days before the appointment.
- Where the visit type requires confirmation and the patient has not confirmed, staff call the visit type's confirmation-call hours before the start.
- Each outreach type is sent once per days-before value.
- The patient is asked to arrive the visit type's arrival minutes before the start (the device-check minutes early for video visits).
- Only the patient confirms an appointment. Confirmation moves the appointment from booked to confirmed.

## Outreach entries

Each reminder, preparation instruction or confirmation call is recorded as one outreach entry on the appointment, showing the outreach kind, the days before the appointment, the channel and the date sent, with an amount of 0.00. One entry exists per outreach kind per days-before value.

## Input — judgement — output

| Input | Judgement | Output |
|---|---|---|
| Visit type with reminder days of, hypothetically, 7 and 2 | one reminder per days-before value | a reminder 7 days before and a reminder 2 days before, each once |
| Visit type requiring confirmation; the patient has not confirmed | the confirmation-call element applies | staff call at the visit type's confirmation-call hours before the start |
| Request that staff confirm the appointment on the patient's behalf | only the patient confirms | the appointment is confirmed only by the patient |
| Preparation-instruction days of, hypothetically, 3 | instructions go out that many days before | preparation instructions sent 3 days before the appointment |

## Worked hypothetical

*Hypothetical:* a visit type with reminder days of 3 and 1, preparation-instruction days of 2 and confirmation required. For an appointment on an invented date, reminders go out 3 days and 1 day before it, each once; preparation instructions go out 2 days before it, once; and if the patient has not confirmed, staff call at the visit type's confirmation-call hours before the start.
